name: Occupancy Map Generation
definition: A GPU compute shader dispatch routine that generates an occupancy map from volume, gradient, and ITF textures using a configurable reduction block size and 2D/3D ITF mode.
summary: Occupancy Map Generation is a GPU compute shader routine that produces a single global binary occupancy map from volume, gradient, and ITF textures, distinguishing itself by generating a global map rather than partitioned variants.
